params.body:
## Summary
- The extra-damage button ("+" / marker 18) sat absolutely positioned inside the damage
  diagram's coordinate space, bottom-left. In French, "Dommages supplémentaires" is wide
  enough to overlap marker 16 (also bottom-left), rendering as
  "Dommages supplé[16]aires" at 1440px. Any language whose translation is longer than the
  Dutch original hits the same wall.
- Fix: move the button out of `.car_explosion` entirely (no more shared percentage
  coordinate space) into a normal `.ui-button`, left-aligned on desktop, full width on
  phone. Marker positions are unchanged.
- Also: on a phone (<768px) the diagram was fully hidden and replaced by the named parts
  list (from a previous fix). Per follow-up request, the diagram now stays visible above
  the list as a read-only picture (its buttons lose click and their fixed 40px size, now
  scaling with the drawing so they no longer overlap at small widths); the list underneath
  is unchanged and remains the only tap target.
- Also: fixed inconsistent capitalisation / a leading article in the French part names
  (`le pare-choc avant` → `Pare-choc avant`, `hayon` → `Hayon`, `porte d'entrée gauche` /
  `Porte d'entrée droite` → `Porte avant gauche` / `Porte avant droite` for naming
  consistency with the existing avant/arrière pattern, `Bonnet` → `Capot`), and matching
  capitalisation fixes in `en` (`tailgate` → `Tailgate`, `front bumper` → `Front bumper`)
  and `de` (`VorderTür` → `Vordertür`, a lowercase-first-letter typo in two entries fixed).
- Updated `docs/bedrijfsregels` rule S1-6.27 (phone damage step) to describe the new
  read-only-diagram-above-list behaviour, and added R S1-6.34 for the extra button's
  coordinate independence, with a dedicated structural test
  (`test_the_extra_damage_button_is_not_inside_the_marker_container`) plus an update to
  the existing phone-list test's CSS assertions.
- Filed a finding for two pre-existing, out-of-scope placeholder translation values
  ("Extra fr", "extra_damage eng") noticed while in this file but not part of the ask.

## Test plan
- [x] `vendor/bin/phpunit --filter "Damage|StylesheetSyntax|AlpineExpression|CompiledViews|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity|HandlerWiring"` — 32 tests, 954 assertions, green.
- [x] Manual screenshots (Playwright) of the vehicle sheet's Schade/Damage/Dommages/Beschädigung tab at 1440px and 390px, in nl/fr/en/de: no overlap between the extra button and any marker in any language, diagram visible and read-only on phone, extra button full width on phone / left-aligned on desktop.
params.title: The extra-damage button leaves the diagram
